ops.body: Fixed by the v0.21.0 cut: the deploy package carries the single coherent recovery verb the record asked for — gate verified Deployment.Reset exists (deploy/deploy.go:442) settling recovery, converging launchd empty, and discarding stale candidate/prior/removal slots and records in one call, with a purge-while-app-intact regression test, and an orphaned canonical app is adoptable via Supersede. Residual (an evidence-preserving archive step before Reset mutates) is narrow enough for its own follow-up, per the lane.
